thread:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx and p99 latency spike observed from edge-sjc-pop for the last 3m. Error cluster: uploads failing. Affected prefixes: 203.0.113.0/24. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2015004321 :rotating_light:

jordan: ack, taking on-call. I'll start triage and ping neteng.

jordan: quick snapshot — 5xx rate ~12% from sjc-pop, client RTT p95 ~1200ms, significant retransmits in tcp stack.

lee: on it. running traceroute -> origin via ISP-A now. initial looks like last-hop retransmits and intermittent timeouts.

lee: traceroute output:
```
traceroute to origin (198.51.100.10), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms  0.4 ms  0.4 ms
 2  isp-agg-1.example.net  3.2 ms  3.1 ms  3.0 ms
 3  isp-agg-3.example.net  *  15.3 ms  *
 4  isp-peering-sjc  *  *  *  (35% loss observed)
 5  origin-gw  45.1 ms  44.9 ms  45.0 ms
```

tim: I'll start steering traffic to fallback pool (sjc-alt-pop + nearby sfo-pop) and spin up extra workers for uploads. Can we do a soft failover first?

deploy-bot: route-policy apply --policy=soft-failover-sjc --prefix=203.0.113.0/24 -> sjc-alt-pop SUCCESS (eta 15s)

jordan: listing customers flagged by alerts: cust-omega, cust-lumen, cust-apex (3 reported upload failures). total active customers in affected region ~1.2k — estimated impacted ~= 0.25%.

lee: running mtr to 198.51.100.10 now. summary: 35% loss at hop 4 (isp-peering-sjc), subsequent hops show intermittent recovery. looks like carrier last-mile jitter/queueing.

alex: suggest enabling client-side additional retries and bumping upload timeout to 90s as stopgap. also consider enabling cache-bypass for uploads to avoid long backoff. snippet:
```bash
# quick nginx proxy tweak (canary)
proxy_read_timeout 90s;
proxy_connect_timeout 10s;
proxy_send_timeout 90s;
```

jordan: applying timeout change to canary pool now, then promote if stable. notifying CS to surface to affected customers.

maria: drafting status page update: "We are investigating upload failures for some customers in US-West (SJC). Mitigation in progress: traffic steering and timeout adjustments. We'll update in 30 minutes." pinging account reps.

tim: traffic steering ongoing — aggregate 5xx rate down from 12% -> 6% in last 5m. p95 latency trending down. continuing to observe.

lee: opening carrier ticket with traceroute + mtr logs, ETA from carrier rep unknown. providing packet capture window 21:08-21:20 UTC.

jordan: declaring this incident Sev2 (operational impact to small % of customers). Handoff note for night oncall at 04:00 UTC: mitigations applied (soft-failover, canary timeout bump), carrier engaged, CS notified, monitoring p95/p99 and 5xx. revert plan: rollback route-policy and timeout tweak if regressions occur.

incident-bot: INC-2015004321 created, severity: Sev2, owner: jordan. Pager schedule notified.

tim: midday check — failover has eliminated majority of errors for affected prefixes. still seeing occasional spikes tied to specific peering paths; will keep backups in place until carrier confirms fix.

maria: three customer tickets opened (TCK-4123, TCK-4124, TCK-4125). sent initial status and ETA placeholder. one enterprise wants an incident call — scheduling if carrier confirms root cause.

alex: please ensure all infra changes are annotated in the incident ticket (route-policy IDs, canary group ids). we'll snapshot routing config for postmortem.

lee: carrier responded: "investigating congestion on aggregator-router SJC-AGR-3, potential SCAN affecting transit. Will advise on mitigation or reroute." shared carrier ticket ref.

jordan: prepping handoff doc now. key items: what we changed (soft-failover applied, proxy timeouts bumped on canary then promoted), monitoring checks (5xx rate, p95, mtr loss at hop 4), customer list, carrier ticket id. will attach logs.

tim: proposed post-incident actions: 1) add more aggressive egress health checks to detect hop-level loss, 2) add automated quick-failover to alternate POP for sustained >10% packet loss, 3) update oncall runbook with specific probes (mtr + tcpdump) for POP ingress issues.

jordan: handoff to night oncall complete. monitoring window requested 2h post-handoff then transition to follow-up. maria will own customer comms until resolved.

maria: status page pushed: https://status.redwood/incident/2015004321 — customers updated.

jordan: closing active mitigation thread — leaving incident open for carrier confirmation and postmortem. will schedule RCA after carrier provides final root cause. thanks all. :thumbsup:
